note: overarm throw, RIGHT hand: ball to the shoulder, front-foot step, wind-up (arm back, hips / shoulders turned), drive through, release forward-up, follow-through across, back foot steps up
camera: Touchline CAMERA_V1 gameplay camera, 1:1 pixels; the 500x450 clip starts at viewport (600,150)
worldFrame: pitch x (east, goal line at x≈105), pitch y (north→south), z up; metres; facing = world heading deg (atan2(dy, dx)); the keeper's RIGHT = (−sin f, cos f)
conventions: authored RIGHT-handed / right-footed; LEFT = mirror of the poses, the in-hand ball path and the hand roles; the hand is the one on the target's side of the keeper's frame at the plan start (central → right); the punt foot comes from the request (default right)
timing: 60 ticks / s; u = (now − t0) / (tRelease − t0) over the preparation, then the follow-through to tEnd; PUNT: DROP at tRelease, the KICK is the tick the falling ball reaches z 0.45 m (tKick = the prediction the foot aims at, tKickActual = the event)
